tests.scenario: Verify the live application against The login page shall display an email input field
steps: Check whether the reported discrepancy is present in the live UI
tests.expected_result: Email input missing on Firefox
tests.rc_reasoning: The acceptance criterion of displaying an email input field on the login page is highly central to the core business value and has a strong dependency on the user story, as it is a fundamental aspect of creating an account, although it does not directly protect user data or core workflow.

tests.scenario: Verify the live application against Users must be able to reset their password via email
steps: Check whether the reported discrepancy is present in the live UI
tests.expected_result: Reset link expires in 5 seconds (too short)
tests.rc_reasoning: The acceptance criterion of password reset via email is highly central to the core business value, dependent on the user story's success, and protects user accounts, thus scoring high on the business criticality scale.

tests.scenario: Verify the live application against Login button should be focusable and clickable
steps: Check whether the reported discrepancy is present in the live UI
tests.expected_result: Login button not focusable with keyboard on Safari
tests.rc_reasoning: The acceptance criterion that the login button should be focusable and clickable is highly central to the core business value and has a high dependency on the user story, as it directly enables users to create an account and use the product, while also protecting the core workflow by ensuring accessibility.
